Abstract

We establish well-posedness and maximal regularity for the fractional Cauchy problem in Hölder space {C_{0}^{\gamma}(E)}. We also prove the existence and stability of new implicit difference schemes for the general approximation of the nonhomogeneous fractional Cauchy problem. Our analysis relies on β-resolvent family theory, functional analysis, and numerical analysis.
